attributes.axis_log: V1 AXES, FOLDED (all reverted, all still do-not-retry): (A) joined declaration+initializer NEUTRAL real 13; (B) bare array decay with the cast moved to the four use sites NEUTRAL; (C) delete the local, direct (char*)sSpeechNameBuf at all sites REGRESSED 13->20 and served as the decisive negative control that the target's own source DOES hold a long-lived local (ours dropped to one saved GPR where target emits stmw r30 saving two); (D) statement reorder past the first call REGRESSED 13->15; (E) dead-local identity reuse folding ch2 into ch NEUTRAL. V2 CENSUS AXES (this pass, all measurement, zero source edits): C1 built tools/gdl/addr16_census.py, joining build/GUNE5D/asm with build/GUNE5D/src across 2983 paired functions and classifying every (function, symbol) ADDR16_LO home as shape A (direct addi into the callee-saved home) or shape B (addi into r0 then mr). Result P=24 target-A/ours-B, Q=28 both-B, R=659 both-A, S=0. C2 S=0 in 683 opportunities establishes the divergence is STRICTLY ONE-DIRECTIONAL at a 3.5% failure rate. C3 symbol-property axes (section/size/alignment) FALSIFIED: 15 of 16 P symbols also appear in R, so the same global takes both shapes; sSpeechNameBuf itself is P in MapMusicStart and AudioSetupLevelStreams but R in ShopMusicStart and InitNameAudio, inside this very TU. C4 prologue-shadow scheduling-flag hypothesis FALSIFIED: target and ours have near-identical shadow histograms and both cap at exactly 4 hoisted instructions; only 34/2983 functions disagree. C5 compiler-build hypothesis FALSIFIED by matchtool probe game/sound/sounds.c: MapMusicStart is L+1/D13 under all six demo-family presets across BOTH GC/1.2.5n and GC/1.2.5 and both inline variants - identical outcome, so neither the compiler version nor the -inline/exceptions flags reach this decision. C6 the v1 mechanism (addi scheduled into the pre-prologue shadow, forced to r0 because the home is not yet saved) is CORRECT FOR THIS FUNCTION but is NOT the general mechanism: it holds for only 12 of the 24 P instances, and the other 12 - including both pmotion instances that founded the parent law - have the addi after the frame on both sides and still pay the copy. The target never places a callee-saved-homed ADDR16_LO addi in the shadow (0/683), so shadow placement is downstream of the coalescing decision, not upstream. C7 formation-earliness and register-pressure axes showed an aggregate signal (P 0.076 vs R 0.192 formation fraction; cs_before P 1.33 vs R 2.61) but BOTH DIE under matched within-TU within-symbol controls, where the R case forms earlier than the P cases (pmotion/lbl_80282850: R get_player_pos 0.028 vs P 0.036 and 0.101). C8 home-formation multiplicity and adjacency FALSIFIED (P 2.00 / Q 2.07 / R 1.96). C9 home-register web multiplicity FALSIFIED for P (single-def 0.750 vs R 0.736) but it SEPARATES Q sharply (mean 3.00 defs, single-def 0.143), which is the classic coalescing-interference condition and explains why retail pays the copy in Q too - this is the POSITIVE CONTROL proving the census is sensitive enough to find a discriminant when one exists in this variable space, so P's null is a genuine null. NO PROBE WAS SPENT on MapMusicStart's source in this pass: the census produced no hypothesis that maps to a non-fakematch source edit, and the discipline is that every probe needs a census-derived hypothesis first. C10 GENERALISATION TEST (integrator request): censused every `mr rCS,r0`/`addi rCS,r0,0` homing image-wide and classified the r0 producer. Of the 31 functions paying surplus homings, 26 have an ADDR16_LO addi as producer and 5 are backward-walk artifacts on non-writing opcodes, so the class is effectively 100% ADDR16_LO. The five parks flagged as sharing a 'related extra-address-copy signature' (LoadItems, StartWorldLoad, init_player_change, pbDrawVerts, ProcessCritterList) carry ZERO r0->callee-saved homings on EITHER side - a DIFFERENT mechanism, not covered by this law, and the do-not-probe disposition does NOT extend to them. The census also independently rediscovered LoadWorldDone and LoadWorldData, the two instances the control-flow lane found by hand, confirming roster completeness.

attributes.residual: UNCHANGED from v1 and now definitively classified: one ours-only `mr r30,r0` at 0x1c; target 52 instructions / ours 53; count-asymmetric, so WebFrank-ineligible on both the recolor-size and permutation-bijection preconditions.
